name: Ojom
description: Ojom was a frozen planet located in the Ojom system in the the galaxy's Deep Core that was the homeworld of the Besalisk species. A frigid world, the native Besalisks lived in communities atop floating glaciers, and the planet rarely received visitors, which made the discovery of the Force-sensitive Pong Krell by the Jedi Order an exceptional occurrence.
